# Palenight

Palenight applies a Monokai Palenight color scheme to Obsidian's interface and editor as a dark theme. Its recorded description states that some CodeMirror 6 selectors remain unstyled and that updates are ongoing.

![Palenight screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nnniv/palenight.obsidian/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Palenight"
    author: "nnniv"
    repo:   "nnniv/palenight.obsidian"
    slug:   "palenight"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/palenight"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/nnniv/palenight.obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nnniv/palenight.obsidian/HEAD/assets/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a Monokai Palenight color scheme to Obsidian for a dark, high-contrast interface and editor. Expect ongoing updates as some CodeMirror 6 selectors remain unstyled while the theme is refined."
}
```
